q: When they listen to that which hath been revealed unto the messengers, thou seest their eyes overflow with tears because of their recognition of the Truth.

s: Christians believe in Our Lord
q: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses.

s: Allah rewards Christians (those who believe and do good works)
q: Allah hath rewarded them for that their saying - Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever.

s: paradise is a Gardens (underneath which rivers flow)
q: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever.

s: disbelievers are owners of hell-fire (those who deny revelations)
q: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.

s: believers are commanded lawful and good things (not to forbid them)
q: O ye who believe! Forbid not the good things which Allah hath made lawful for you

s: Allah does not love transgressors
q: Allah loveth not transgressors.

s: oaths has expiation the feeding of ten of the needy
q: The expiation thereof is the feeding of ten of the needy with the average of that wherewith ye feed your own folk, or the clothing of them, or the liberation of a slave

s: Children of Israel is wilfully blind blind (many of them)
q: Now (even after that) are many of them wilfully blind and deaf.

s: strong drink is a infamy (of Satan's handiwork)
q: Strong drink and games of chance and idols and divining arrows are only an infamy of Satan's handiwork.

s: games of chance is a infamy (of Satan's handiwork)
q: Strong drink and games of chance and idols and divining arrows are only an infamy of Satan's handiwork.

s: Satan causes enmity (by means of strong drink and games of chance)
q: Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance

s: Satan turns away from remembrance of Allah (by means of strong drink and games of chance)
q: and to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship.

s: Allah commands obedience (through the messenger)
q: Obey Allah and obey the messenger

s: Allah tries believers (with game taken by hands and spears)
q: Allah will surely try you somewhat (in the matter) of the game which ye take with your hands and your spears

s: wild game is forbidden during pilgrimage (when intentionally hunted on land)
q: Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage.

s: Children of Israel is wilfully deaf deaf (many of them)
q: Now (even after that) are many of them wilfully blind and deaf.

s: wild game requires domestic animals (as equivalent forfeit when killed intentionally)
q: he shall pay its forfeit in the equivalent of that which he hath killed, of domestic animals

s: pilgrimage forbids hunting on land (during pilgrimage)
q: but to hunt on land is forbidden you so long as ye are on the pilgrimage.

s: Sacred House is a Sacred House (appointed as a standard for mankind)
q: Allah hath appointed the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, a standard for mankind

s: Allah knows heavens and earth (whatsoever is in them)
q: Allah knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth

s: Allah knows all things
q: and that Allah is Knower of all things.

s: Allah is severe in punishment
q: Know that Allah is severe in punishment

s: Jesus, son of Mary is a messengers (a messenger)
q: The Messiah, son of Mary, was no other than a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) had passed away before him.

s: Allah is forgiving forgiveness
q: but that Allah (also) is Forgiving, Merciful.

s: Qur'an is revealed revelations (during questioning)
q: but if ye ask of them when the Qur'an is being revealed, they will be made known unto you.

s: believers have charge of own souls
q: O ye who believe! Ye have charge of your own souls.
